answer: Reaching eligibility takes 45 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. The terrace register is checked at draw time, glacier lists the eligible set, and relic seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 45 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. The deposit is 31 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
